preamble.title: apex-fusion/identity-marketplace
preamble.description: Vector identity registry (did:vector) with attestation, delegation, vault, escrow and advert contracts.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

identity_marketplace/types/AdvertDatum.title: AdvertDatum
identity_marketplace/types/AdvertDatum.description:
The new advert datum: `Constr 0` with 14 fields. Fields 0..12 are the legacy
 advert datum in the legacy order; field 13 is new.

   0  supplier_pkh            ByteArray(28)
   1  capability_id           ByteArray (UTF-8)
   2  model                   ByteArray (UTF-8)
   3  max_output_tokens       Int
   4  max_processing_ms       Int
   5  price_lovelace          Int
   6  supplier_bond_lovelace  Int
   7  buyer_bond_lovelace     Int
   8  endpoint_url            ByteArray (UTF-8)
   9  detail_uri              ByteArray (UTF-8)
   10 detail_hash             ByteArray(32)
   11 advertised_at           Int (POSIX ms)
   12 status                  AdvertStatus
   13 agent_id                ByteArray(32)

identity_marketplace/types/AdvertRedeeme.title: AdvertRedeemer
identity_marketplace/types/AdvertRedeeme.description:
Advert redeemers, in the legacy order: PostAdvert=121, UpdateAdvert=122,
 RetireAdvert=123.

identity_marketplace/types/AdvertStatus.title: AdvertStatus
identity_marketplace/types/AdvertStatus.description: Advert status, in the legacy order: Active=121, Retired=122.

fields.title: issuer_id
fields.description: Set when the issuer is a registered agent.

fields.title: att_type
fields.description:
0 identity, 1 provenance, 2 software, 3 environment, 4 principal
 binding, 5 approval, 15 other; others reserved.

fields.title: format
fields.description: CoAP Content-Format of the document; `None` = unspecified.

fields.title: profile
fields.description: 32 bytes: hash of the profile or type URI.

anyOf.title: PrincipalKey
anyOf.description: `organisation`: DID or domain of an organisation, 1..64 bytes.

identity_marketplace/types/EscrowDatum.title: EscrowDatum
identity_marketplace/types/EscrowDatum.description:
The new escrow datum: `Constr 0` with 16 fields. Fields 0..13 are the
 legacy escrow datum (`contracts/marketplace/lib/marketplace/types.ak`) in
 the legacy order; fields 14 and 15 are new.

   0  buyer_pkh               ByteArray(28)
   1  supplier_pkh            ByteArray(28)
   2  advert_ref              OutputReference
   3  capability_id           ByteArray (UTF-8)
   4  request_spec_hash       ByteArray(32)
   5  prompt_hash             ByteArray(32)
   6  payment_lovelace        Int
   7  buyer_bond_lovelace     Int
   8  supplier_bond_lovelace  Int
   9  deliver_by              Int (POSIX ms)
   10 posted_at               Int (POSIX ms)
   11 submitted_at            Option<Int>
   12 result_receipt_hash     Option<ByteArray>
   13 state                   EscrowState
   14 agent_id                ByteArray(32), from the advert
   15 refund                  Option<Refund>; None = the buyer key

identity_marketplace/types/EscrowRedeeme.title: EscrowRedeemer
identity_marketplace/types/EscrowRedeeme.description:
Escrow redeemers, in the legacy order (Claim=121, Submit=122, Accept=123,
 Reclaim=124, Release=125), then `RefundRevoked` (126).

identity_marketplace/types/EscrowState.title: EscrowState
identity_marketplace/types/EscrowState.description:
Escrow states, in the legacy order: Open=121, Claimed=122, Submitted=123,
 Accepted=124, Reclaimed=125, Released=126.

identity_marketplace/types/Link.title: Link
identity_marketplace/types/Link.description:
`rel`: 0 supersedes, 1 depends_on, 2 corroborates, 3 disputes. `target`:
 token name of another attestation (32 bytes).

identity_marketplace/types/Refund.title: Refund
identity_marketplace/types/Refund.description:
Where buyer payouts go: outputs at exactly `address`, with no datum when
 `datum` is `None`, or with the inline datum `d` when it is `Some(d)`.

vector_identity/redeemers/Actor.title: Actor
vector_identity/redeemers/Actor.description: The author of a `Suspend` or a `Revoke`.

anyOf.title: ByParty
anyOf.description: Index of the acting party in the spent record's `parties`.

vector_identity/redeemers/IdentityMint.title: IdentityMint
vector_identity/redeemers/IdentityMint.description: Mint redeemer of the identity policy.

vector_identity/redeemers/IdentitySpend.title: IdentitySpend
vector_identity/redeemers/IdentitySpend.description: Spend redeemer of the identity contract.

vector_identity/types/Signer.title: Signer
vector_identity/types/Signer.description: The signer of a party, a hold or a revocation.

anyOf.title: Script
anyOf.description: 28 bytes; only the approved Module-1 contract.
